source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of creating a marketing plan (PDF 216).

blocks.text: Marketing plan batata hai ke target market tak kaise pohanchna hai, social media, television ya zabani tashheer jaise promotional raaston samait. Pakistani masalon ka naya brand launch karne ke liye cooking shows par ishtihar ya riwayati khanon par tawajjo dene wale social media influencers ke saath kaam kiya ja sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Masalon ka brand sports channel ki bajaye cooking show par kyun?
blocks.explanation: Cooking show dekhne wale masale khareedne ke sab se zyada imkan wale log hain, to paisa durust sameen tak pohanchta hai.

items: Marketing plan: aise raaste chunein jo target gahakon tak pohanchein.
